# [(B) Scientific Reporting]{style="font-size: 80%;"}

[*Three territories of the reporting workflow, each solving a distinct problem.*]{style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 80%; width: 100%;"}
**B1** [Manipulation]{style="color: red;"} — Raw data arrives in the shape of its source, not of our question; [`./manipulation`]{style="color: red;"} is where we reshape it and earn a trustworthy rectangle.

**B2** [Analysis]{style="color: red;"} — Data does not speak on its own; [`./analysis`]{style="color: red;"} is where we compose and catalogue the artifacts created during interrogation.

**B3** [Frontend]{style="color: red;"} — Some reports will never face external readers; [`./_frontend-N`]{style="color: red;"} is where we decide what to show, to whom, and how.
:::


## B1 `./manipulation` {background-color="#D6EAF8" style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

[The rectangle we need is never the rectangle we are given. Manipulation is where we earn it. ]{style="font-size: 85%;"}

[Representative issues and challenges:]{style="font-size: 65%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 68%;"}

**Grain confusion** — two tables joined at different levels of aggregation silently inflate counts; always state the unit before the join

**Universe filters** — some questions are asked only of a subset; applying analysis to the full sample treats non-answers as implicit responses

**Naming drift** — the same concept is spelled differently across sources or vintages; a rename script quietly forks the schema

**Label–value mismatch** — factor labels in the codebook do not match the stored codes; recoding from memory rather than the codebook corrupts the variable

:::
:::

::: {.column style="font-size: 80%;"}

Territory in this project

::: {style="font-size: 0.87em;"}
```text
./manipulation/
├── 0-extract-dictionary/
│   └── 0-extract-dictionary.py
├── 0-extract-metadata.R    harvest SPSS labels
├── 1-ferry.R               .sav  ──► cchs-1.sqlite
├── 2-ellis.R               ──► cchs_analytic.parquet
├── 3-test-ellis-cache.R    24 assertions
├── pipeline.md             execution + diagnostics
├── pipeline-project-spec.md   cohort contract
└── pipeline-validation.dcf    declares the target

./data-public/metadata/
├── INPUT-manifest.md       what arrived
└── CACHE-manifest.md       what is served

./
flow.R                      runs the lanes in order
config.yml                  where the sources live
```
:::

How data is refined into a worthy rectangle

::: {style="font-size: 0.90em;"}
```text
sample_flow             n remaining     excluded
0  full pooled sample       126,431            —
1  age 15-75                112,352       14,079
2  employed past 3 mo        64,248       48,104
3  non-proxy respondent      64,248            0
4  complete LOP outcome      63,843          405
```
:::
:::
:::

## B2 `./analysis` {background-color="#FDEBD0" style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

[A clean rectangle is silent. Analysis is where we build the instruments that make it speak.]{style="font-size: 85%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 68%;"}
**Scope discipline** — one folder holds one monothematic engagement, not a drawer of everything

**Provenance** — every derived table and figure traces back to a documented source column, not to memory

**Variation is evidence** — alternate cuts of the same question are siblings, not replacements; the discarded view stays part of the record

**A scratch pad is not a report** — until it renders, it does not exist

**Genre shapes expectation** — each engagement belongs to a recognizable form: exploratory (EDA), inferential (model estimation), or presentational (report)
:::
:::

::: {.column style="font-size: 80%;"}

Territory in this project

::: {style="font-size: 0.90em;"}
```text
analysis/
├── README.md               the index of what exists
├── data-primer-1/          validated, canonical reference
├── eda-5/    outcome — decompose the 8 LOP parts
├── eda-61/   exposure — chronic conditions
├── eda-62/   predisposing — who the worker is
├── eda-63/   facilitating — access and behaviour
├── eda-64/   needs — perceived health, ADL
├── eda-65/   missingness
├── eda-71/   outcome — distribution shapes
└── eda-72/   predisposing × outcome groups

analysis/eda-61/            one engagement, in full
├── report-contract.prompt.md
├── eda-61.R                laboratory
├── eda-61.qmd              publication layer
├── prints/                 8.5 × 5.5 in @ 300 dpi
├── figure-png-iso/
└── data-local/
```
:::

[How one engagement moves]{style="font-size: 75%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 0.90em;"}
```text
report-contract.prompt.md   the question, agreed in writing
        │
        ▼
     eda-61.R    laboratory    ──ggsave()──►  prints/
        │  read_chunk()
        ▼
     eda-61.qmd  publication   ──render──►    eda-61.html
```
:::
:::
:::

## B3 `_frontend-*` {background-color="#EBDEF0" style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

[A repository is not an argument. The frontend is where we choose the reader, and answer for the choice.]{style="font-size: 85%;"}B

::: {style="font-size: 68%;"}
**Exposure** — private paths, credentials, and working notes must not survive the trip to a public artifact

**Register** — a filename or a command is meaningful to an engineer and noise to an external reader

**Custody** — a document copied verbatim must arrive unedited, or the site must say plainly that it did not

**Assembly** — many independently authored reports must appear under one coherent navigation without being rewritten

**Self-containment** — a published page owns its own assets, or it rots the moment the source repository moves
:::
:::

::: {.column style="font-size: 78%;"}

Territory in this project

::: {style="font-size: 0.85em;"}
```text
_frontend-1/
├── publishing-contract.prompt.md   the editorial spec
├── _quarto.yml                     the navbar is the offer
├── content/                        EDITED
│   ├── index.qmd                   COMPOSED
│   ├── site-map.qmd                COMPOSED
│   ├── project/
│   │   └── project-proposal.qmd    ADAPTED
│   ├── pipeline/
│   │   ├── pipeline-guide.qmd      ADAPTED
│   │   ├── cache-manifest.qmd      VERBATIM
│   │   └── input-manifest.qmd      VERBATIM
│   ├── data-primer/                ADAPTED + REDIRECT
│   ├── analysis/                   7 × REDIRECT
│   └── images/
├── scripts/
│   ├── copy-contract-assets.R      pre-render
│   ├── copy-analysis-html.R        post-render
│   └── audit-fidelity.R            the gate
├── FIDELITY_REPORT.md   protocol honoured?
├── TRANSFORM_LOG.md     what was changed, and why
├── BUILD_REPORT.md      did every page arrive?
└── _site/                          PRINTED
```
:::

[How the protocols move content]{style="font-size: 75%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 0.87em;"}
```text
RAW                     protocol      EDITED        PRINTED
CACHE-manifest.md  ──►  VERBATIM   ─┐
pipeline.md        ──►  ADAPTED    ─┤
eda-72.html        ──►  REDIRECT   ─┼─► content/ ──► _site/
(no single source) ──►  COMPOSED   ─┘
                                    │
                    TRANSFORM_LOG.md — every change, with a reason
```
:::
:::
:::

# (C) Agent Harnesses {style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%"}

**Pipeline Orchestra**

[*Engineering: raw data → trustworthy rectangle*]{style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 65%;"}
**Agent** `@pipeline-engineer`

**Writes to** `manipulation/`

**Flow** source → ferry → ellis → served

**Governs** transport, transformation, and validation of incoming data

**Accountability** INPUT-manifest records what arrived; CACHE-manifest records what is served
:::
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

**Composing Orchestra**

[*Reporting: clean data → analytical artifact*]{style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 65%;"}
**Agent** `@report-composer`

**Writes to** `analysis/`

**Flow** contract → `.R` laboratory → `.qmd` publication

**Governs** monothematic engagement: one question, one folder, one artifact family

**Accountability** report-contract anchors scope; artifacts are numbered and inventoried
:::
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}

**Publishing Orchestra**

[*Publishing: existing artifacts → curated site*]{style="font-size: 80%;"}

::: {style="font-size: 65%;"}
**Agents** `@interviewer` + `@writer`

**Writes to** `_frontend-N/`

**Flow** RAW → EDITED (`content/`) → PRINTED (`_site/`)

**Governs** editorial selection, audience register, and protocol fidelity

**Accountability** TRANSFORM_LOG records every change; fidelity report is the gate
:::
:::
:::
